title: Salicylic acid engages central metabolic regulators SnRK1 and TOR to govern immunity by differential phosphorylation of NPR1.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC full text returned HTTP 500 (not open access), supplement endpoint returned no zip, zero accessions in text or text-mined, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject), no Zenodo/Dryad hits on the DOI. A PRIDE (proteomics archive) keyword search for NPR1/SnRK1/TOR returned no projects.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about content comes from the abstract: a mechanistic Arabidopsis study of NPR1 (an immune regulator protein) phosphorylation at a few sites (Ser-55/59, Ser-557) by TOR and SnRK1 kinases, using targeted experiments rather than a large dataset.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found: no accessions, no supplement retrievable, no repository hits; checked via APIs, not just the paper.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table exists; any label (phosphosite status, immune outcome) would have to be constructed from figures of a handful of mutants.

a5_enough_rows.note: Mechanistic study of a few phosphosites on one protein; effectively a handful of data points, not hundreds.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Measurements would be wet-lab assays (phosphorylation, immune readouts), not model outputs, but none are deposited as a table.

backbone.name: ESM-2 (protein language model) would be the only plausible fit, for phosphosite prediction

honest_claim_h3: No model claim is possible: the paper characterises a few phosphorylation sites on one plant protein and deposits no dataset.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use plant protein sequences to predict which sites the nutrient-sensing kinases TOR and SnRK1 phosphorylate.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need many kinase-substrate sites; this paper contributes about three sites on one protein (NPR1). Number of usable examples: unknown, effectively near zero.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a serine is phosphorylated by TOR or SnRK1, from in vitro kinase assays and mutant studies in the paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Plant immunity researchers could prioritise kinase targets, but this paper alone supplies too few labels to train or test anything.

label_elsewhere.sources: Known resources: PhosPhAt and the Plant PTM Viewer hold Arabidopsis phosphosites, but kinase-specific labels for TOR/SnRK1 are sparse (not searched).
label_elsewhere.why: Any phosphosite project would rest on those external databases, not on this paper.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper; a TOR/SnRK1 substrate-site predictor would have to be built from external phosphosite databases.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Look for any deposited proteomics/omics accession in the data availability statement; none found via APIs.

verdict_reason: Mechanistic single-protein study with no deposited dataset: no accessions, no retrievable supplement, no repository hits, so A1, A2 and A5 fail.
